instruction: In your browser, create two new folders on the bookmarks bar: one called 'Work' and another called 'Personal'.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating two bookmark folders named 'Work' and 'Personal' on the bookmarks bar. Uses existing Chrome evaluator functions (is_expected_bookmarks with bookmark_bar_folders_names type checking for both folder names). No custom functions needed - reuses official getter/metric.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly reads Chrome Bookmarks file and extracts bookmark structure
Metric correctly filters for folders on bookmark bar and checks for both required folder names ('Work' and 'Personal')
Complete coverage - all instruction requirements are verified (both folder creations)
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to ensure bookmarks are persisted to disk before verification
Expected values match instruction requirements exactly
Edge cases handled correctly (missing folders, partial completion, empty state)
